prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Coloured full-body bestiary portrait, grounded hand-painted realistic game illustration. Broad readable brushwork, smooth light-to-shadow gradients across large forms, quiet surfaces with selective crisp detail at silhouette and focal features. No uniform high-frequency texture, craquelure, fractal cracks or sharpening noise. Soft upper-left light, muted natural colours. Empty dark charcoal subtly mottled backdrop, restrained contact shading only. Entire subject, feet, tails and tips inside comfortable margins. Portrait aspect about 4:5. No captions, symbols, border or circular crop. 
One ordinary professional convoy guard, adult man with medium build, short hair, practical alert face. Olive-brown field jacket over simple dark protective vest, muted canvas trousers, boots, plain cap, two modest magazine pouches. Holds ONE compact Thompson-like submachine gun with BOX magazine at low ready, both hands on this same weapon, muzzle lowered. Simple baton at belt. Serviceable modest gear, no high-tech helmet, glowing optics, faction patch or exaggerated armour. Human two arms/two legs, full-body three-quarter standing pose, natural separated hands and weapon grip, no firing. Painting reference only, no copied character or tattoos.
